Abebook.description: Cambridge University Press paperback in the Roman Literature and its Contexts series; first published 1998, this copy from the 2001 digital reprint. Trade softcover in black and turquoise laminated wrappers, no dust jacket as issued. Near-new apart from very slight bumping to the corners and a few light pencil markings in the text; the laminate is bright and unscuffed, the spine uncreased and unfaded, and the binding tight and square. All Latin and Greek is translated or closely paraphrased.
